sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!

sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Why did the train have to stall today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and frustrated, feeling panicked that bad luck is ruining her chance to start the term properly, with a strong edge of exasperated disbelief.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s abruptly startled and confused, her urgency momentarily giving way to wary curiosity as she tries to make sense of the trembling figure ahead.

sprite_sequence.text: Whoa, seriously? Don't move, okay? I'm here.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She shifts instantly from frantic impatience to protective concern, feeling urgent sympathy for the lost boy and determined to steady him and take charge.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: ...Ah, man. Fine. First day and I'm already doomed.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels frustrated and resigned about being late, but her concern for the crying boy has overridden her own panic, leaving her with a determined, slightly exasperated sense of self-sacrifice.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s pushing past her frustration and lateness to focus on helping the boy, sounding brisk and caring with a determined, reassuring edge.
sprite_sequence.label: interested_attentive

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, Kota. I'm Aoi. We're going to find your mom together.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quick shift from frustrated panic to determined, reassuring protectiveness, choosing to take charge and help the boy despite being worried about being late.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Did you come from the station? The bakery? Somewhere with lots of people?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and reassuring, with her earlier panic set aside as she quickly thinks through possibilities and tries to guide the boy calmly.
sprite_sequence.label: interested_attentive

sprite_sequence.text: Got it. Flower shop. Come on, hold my sleeve tight.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels focused and protective, pushing aside her own panic about being late so she can calmly take charge and keep the frightened boy close.
sprite_sequence.label: interested_attentive

sprite_sequence.text: Excuse me! Did anyone see a woman looking for a little kid in a yellow cap?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is focused and urgent, pushing past her own panic about being late to sound confident and helpful while actively taking charge of the search.
sprite_sequence.label: interested_attentive

sprite_sequence.text: It's okay. He stayed near the crossing. He was really trying to be brave.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and quietly proud, softening into warm reassurance as she downplays the scare and praises the boy’s courage.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Next time, don't chase buses, okay? They're not that interesting.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s relieved and quietly proud after helping them reunite, and she covers her lingering concern with a light, teasing joke to keep the mood cheerful.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, wow. I am absolutely dead.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a mix of comic despair and lingering panic about being late, but underneath it she’s relieved and quietly proud that she helped the boy.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels breathless, a little resigned about being late, but warmly satisfied and quietly proud that helping Kota was absolutely the right choice.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile
